rulesStrings.li: raid(raidProperty==Breacher) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [FACTION] raided the colony using breaching tactics.
raid(raidProperty==Sapper) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [FACTION] raided the colony using sapper tactics.
raid(raidProperty==CenterDrop)->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [FACTION] raided the colony by dropping directly into it.
raidFriendly(hostileFaction==) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [FACTION] came to aid the colony.
raidFriendly(hostileFaction==true)->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [FACTION] came to aid the colony against [HOSTILEFACTION].
bodyPartRemoved(intent==Amputate) ->[PAWN]'s [Part] was amputated by [Doctor] due to [BadHediff].
bodyPartInstalled(type==Fix) ->[Doctor] installed a healthy [AddedPart] on [PAWN] to treat [BadHediff].
bodyPartModded(type==Fix) ->[Doctor] installed a [AddedHediff] on [PAWN] to treat [BadHediff][ViolationNote].
tradeCaravanArrived->[PAWN] arrived as part of a [TraderKind] caravan from [FACTION].
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==Timeout) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==DangerousTemperature)->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony because of dangerous temperature.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==AnomalousWeather) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony because of anomalous weather.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==Trapped) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [FACTION] attempted to leave because the caravan became trapped inside.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==TraderLost) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony after their trader or caravan animal was incapacitated.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==PawnLost) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony after some of their members were lost.
visitorArrived->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [FACTION] arrived to visit the colony.
travelGroupArrived->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [FACTION] passed by the colony.
mentalBreak(name==Berserk) ->[PAWN] went berserk. [PAWN_pronoun] was going to attack anyone [PAWN_pronoun] sees. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==FireStartingSpree) ->[PAWN] was on a fire starting spree. [PAWN_pronoun] wandered around for a while, randomly starting fires. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==Catatonic) ->[PAWN] suffered a total mental breakdown and entered a catatonic state for several days. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==Jailbreaker) ->[PAWN] had a mental breakdown and was going to induce [PRISONERS] to escape. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==RunWild) ->[PAWN] was fed up with civilization. [PAWN_pronoun] decided to leave [FACTION] to live with the animals in the wild. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==GiveUpExit) ->[PAWN] gave up on this community. [PAWN_pronoun] decided to leave and pursue a better life elsewhere. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==Binging_DrugExtreme) ->[PAWN] binged on [DRUG] during an extreme mental break. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==Binging_DrugMajor) ->[PAWN] binged on [DRUG] during a major mental break. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==Wander_Psychotic) ->[PAWN] wandered around in a psychotic state. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==Wander_Sad) ->[PAWN] broke down and wandered around in sadness. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==Tantrum) ->[PAWN] had a tantrum. [PAWN_pronoun] was going to smash up random furniture, items and structures. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==TargetedTantrum) ->[PAWN] had a tantrum. [PAWN_pronoun] was going to destroy [THING]. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==BedroomTantrum) ->[PAWN] had a tantrum. [PAWN_pronoun] was going to smash things in [PAWN_possessive] room. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==SadisticRage) ->[PAWN] flew into a sadistic rage. [PAWN_pronoun] was going to vent [PAWN_possessive] anger on the prisoners. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==InsultingSpree) ->[PAWN] was on an insulting spree. [PAWN_pronoun] was going to wander around, randomly insulting others. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==Slaughterer) ->[PAWN] had a mental breakdown and was going to vent [PAWN_possessive] anger by slaughtering [TARGET]. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==TargetedInsultingSpree) ->[PAWN] fixated [PAWN_possessive] rage on [TARGET]. [PAWN_pronoun] was going to follow [TARGET_objective] around, hurling insults. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==CorpseObsession) ->[PAWN] became obsessed with corpses. [PAWN_pronoun] was going to find and present [TARGET]'s corpse for all to see. [REASON]
mentalBreak(name==MurderousRage) ->[PAWN] flew into a murderous rage and decided to kill [TARGET]. [REASON]
prisonBreak(initiator==true)->[PAWN] started a prison break. [PAWN_pronoun] broke the locks open and tried to escape[WithOthers].
prisonBreak(initiator==) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] joined [INITIATOR]'s prison break and tried to escape.
jailbreaker(initiator==) ->[Reason] As a result, [PAWN][AndOthers] started a prison break.
